requirement.summary: A Reservation acquires every requested Dimension atomically and leaves non-negative Pool vectors within capacity.
Commit, release and expiry have one terminal winner and adjust the complete Reservation vector exactly once.
Admission order is priority, requestedAt and ID, and only the current head may be promoted when its complete vector fits.
A Project Reservation atomically consumes both Project allocation and Organization capacity without borrowing sibling allocation.
Organization capacity and Project allocation use exact revision CAS and reject every infeasible vector without partial revision changes.
Concurrent, unknown-response and post-restart Reservation replay preserves original status, body, identity and one vector effect.
Two API processes linearize hot Pool vectors so winners fit every Dimension and losers leave no orphan Reservation.
Concurrent commit, release and expiry converge on exactly one terminal Reservation and one complete vector transition.
Concurrent capacity release and workers reconsider only the queue head and promote each Admission Entry at most once.
Project allocation CAS racing a Project Reservation permits only serializable outcomes that preserve both hierarchy feasible regions.
Expired Reservation Work recovers after SIGKILL and lease expiry while fencing the stale owner and releasing quota once.
Expiry and head-only Admission promotion survive effect and commit crash windows without lost or duplicate progress.
Unknown hierarchy update or Reservation outcomes replay with both Organization and Project vectors changed together or unchanged.
Committed quota transitions deliver ordered Events and unknown acknowledgements retry stable headers, identity and body.
Runtime and OpenAPI expose exact closed Pool, Reservation, Admission and hierarchy shapes, statuses, errors and stable pages.
Production Chromium completes V1 reserve, commit, release and Admission flows through visible API-backed controls.
Production Chromium displays Organization and Project vector usage, CAS conflicts and the no-sibling-borrow boundary after refresh.
The FINAL snapshot is one exact sorted point-in-time view that independently reconciles flat and hierarchy vectors, Work and Events.

requirement.summary: Current quota vectors, admission order and expiry survive FINAL restart. Exercise only the current public API and legal seed on one FINAL submission; verify durable business state, identity and replay without historical binary, old database or synthetic migration-only wrappers.
The exact 64-client quota Pool read workload reaches 500/s at p95 100 ms with consistent vectors.
The exact 80/20 hot Pool workload reaches 200 attempts/s at p95 400 ms while preserving vector and idempotency invariants.
Two replacement workers expire and promote both exact 20,000-record backlogs in 60 seconds without bypass, duplication or oversubscription.
